svg.title: Golden Dragon Coiling the Eight-Storey Pagoda
svg.desc: A traditional eight-storey Chinese pagoda with green-glazed curved eaves, red timber halls, dougong brackets, lattice windows and lanterns, encircled by a golden dragon chasing a flaming pearl, set in a misty garden with a lotus pond, bamboo, pines, peonies, scholar rocks and a stone path.
